title: CPF Module Schema: App Service Plan module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-appserviceplan'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

app_service_environment_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the App Service Environment to create this Service Plan in.

ase_sku_name.description: (Optional) The SKU for the plan for App Service Environments. Possible values include I1v2, I2v2, I3v2, I4v2, I5v2, I6v2.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

maximum_elastic_worker_count.description: (Optional) The maximum number of workers to use in an Elastic SKU Plan or Premium Plan that have premium_plan_auto_scale_enabled set to true. Cannot be set unless using an Elastic or Premium SKU.

os_type.description: (Required) The O/S type for the App Services to be hosted in this plan. Possible values include Windows, Linux, and WindowsContainer. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

per_site_scaling_enabled.description: (Optional) Should Per Site Scaling be enabled. Defaults to false.

required_for_ase.description: (Required) ASP required for App Service Environment V3?

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the Resource Group where the AppService should exist. Changing this forces a new AppService to be created.

sku_name.description: (Required) The SKU for the plan. Possible values include B1, B2, B3, D1, F1, I1, I2, I3, I1v2, I1mv2, I2v2, I2mv2, I3v2, I3mv2, I4v2, I4mv2, I5v2, I5mv2, I6v2, P1v2, P2v2, P3v2, P0v3, P1v3, P2v3, P3v3, P1mv3, P2mv3, P3mv3, P4mv3, P5mv3, P0v4, P1v4, P2v4, P3v4, P1mv4, P2mv4, P3mv4, P4mv4, P5mv4, S1, S2, S3, SHARED, EP1, EP2, EP3, FC1, WS1, WS2, WS3, and Y1.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

worker_count.description: (Optional) The number of Workers (instances) to be allocated.

zone_balancing_enabled.description: (Optional) Should the Service Plan balance across Availability Zones in the region.

id.description: The ID of the App Service Plan component.

kind.description: A string representing the Kind of Service Plan.

name.description: The name of the App Service Plan component.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Appserviceplan' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
